entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: This is the place!

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: "Maid Takoyaki"?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: New customers! I'll show you all to your[n]seats.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: ...So it's your class's stand.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: It's still a refreshment stand, isn't it?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: It's like a deserted island here...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Well, I guess it's good for talking since[n]there aren't any people here...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: We heard a lot of rumors even on our[n]way here.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: And it was all bullshit.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Here she comes... Act normal.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Who cares? There's nothin' "normal"[n]about this anymore.

entries.speaker: Student Maid
entries.en: Welcome home!

entries.speaker: Student Maid
entries.en: May I take your order?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: "Take my order"!? What happened to the[n]maid atmosphere!?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: There are a lot of odd flavors...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Stick to a normal one. I bet they—

entries.speaker: Student Maid
entries.en: I'm so sorry. We sold our last normal one[n]to the previous customer.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: The hell...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Well then... I'll have the mentai cheese[n]takoyaki.

entries.speaker: Student Maid
entries.en: I'm sorry. We're out of cod roe.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Then, how about the squid—

entries.speaker: Student Maid
entries.en: Um... We're currently out catching squid.[n]It'll probably take another five or six[n]hours...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: That doesn't even sound remotely[n]possible! Ain't this whole menu just[n]a sham!?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Actually, we spent most of our budget on[n]making the maid costumes look nice.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: We didn't put too much effort into[n]the octopus.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I can see that!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Ryuji, you're making a scene...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Then, what would you recommend with[n]what you have now?

entries.speaker: Student Maid
entries.en: That would be the Russian takoyaki.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: We'll have that, please.

entries.speaker: Student Maid
entries.en: This will take a little time.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: ...Let's forget about the octopus and get[n]back on topic.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: On that note, hearing Kamoshida being[n]almost treated like a victim makes me[n]wanna eat my stress away!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I've even heard conjecture that the[n]principal was targeted for reasons like[n]"he knew too much."

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I kept hearing about Goro Akechi's[n]popularity.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: All thanks to the Phantom Thieves!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: You know, did that Akechi guy agree[n]to show up here 'cause he believes we[n]didn't kill anybody...?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Or, he may simply love large gatherings.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Oh, true. He didn't seem like he minded[n]being pampered by the media at all.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: We plan on stealing intel, but we might[n]fall into another trap. I'm gonna be[n]bummed if that happens...
Hell no.
That is possible...
Is the takoyaki done yet?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I'm of the same mind.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: We won't let that happen!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: You're so carefree... Does it mean you[n]have nerves of steel in any situation?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Still, it doesn't change the fact that we[n]don't know what Akechi-kun is planning.

entries.speaker: Student Maid
entries.en: Thank you for the wait.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Ooh, it's fresh made!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Lies! I heard a microwave go off!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Well, it's not like I was expectin' crispy[n]takoyaki at a school festival or anything.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: So, what makes this a "Russian" takoyaki?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Could there be jam in it as a secret[n]ingredient? That sounds quite delicious.

entries.speaker: Student Maid
entries.en: Well... one of these is "special."

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Uh, one of them's obviously red.[n]That's gotta be the one.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Dude, don't tell me the "Russian" part[n]means...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: It's like, going for the obvious one is[n]manly?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I-Is that so?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I'd prefer the most beautifully shaped[n]one... but all of them are misshapen.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Oh, aren't you all going to eat? I think[n]I'll go for the "special" one.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Wait... Is she honestly going for it?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Do YOU wanna go for the red one?
No, thank you.
I'll take it.
Think it'll be spicy?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Oh, you sure? All right, then I'll just[n]help myself to it... NOT!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Ooh! Impressive as always!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Uh... well, yeah.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Oh, everyone's all here.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Th-The panel isn't until tomorrow[n]though...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I came to check out the venue. I can't[n]make any mistakes since a lot of people[n]will be present.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Someone's eager.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: But, people ended up recognizing me.[n]Everyone bombarded me with questions.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: That's 'cause you were sloppy...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I grew tired of the baseless rumors they[n]kept bringing up, so I escaped to where[n]there weren't any people.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: ...I'm going to have one of these.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: *gasp* The "special" one!

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Let's just call this my performance fee.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: But—

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: It's fine.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Mmm, it's quite deli—

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: ...HNNNGH!?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Eating it in one bite is a bad idea...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Ngh... My throat...! Urgh! This is...!

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Ohhh... Oh, my stomach... It burns!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Are you okay? Do you need water?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I-I-I'm... I'm fine! I just love... uh... spicy—[n]spicy stuff... Haha... hah...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Hey, does he sound broken to you?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: W-Well then... I'll... I'll see you... uh...[n]t-t-t-tomorrow.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Wow, he's really trying to hold it together.[n]He's waddling around like some comedian.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: It's like he wants to get picked up for[n]some commercial or somethin'...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: But... did he truly come to simply[n]check the venue?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: ...This isn't good. I keep suspecting[n]every little thing...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: ...I know what you mean. I'm doing[n]the same too.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I need to do my best tomorrow. We need[n]to somehow get him to be our source of[n]intel...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I'm gonna pull this off no matter what!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: That Akechi guy...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: ...When he got here, didn't he say that[n]everyone's all here?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: "Everyone"?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: You're... You're just imaginin' things...
